mechanism: Lactulose-induced diarrhea increases fluid and electrolyte loss, which potentiates torsemide's diuretic and electrolyte-depleting effects, increasing risk of hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, and dehydration.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly and consider electrolyte supplementation; adjust lactulose dose to maintain soft stools without excessive diarrhea; monitor blood pressure and renal function.
